<a id="what-pooled-coupling-reaches--合起来的耦合及于什么"></a>
# What pooled coupling reaches

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-pooled-coupling-reaches` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](what-pooled-coupling-reaches.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A pool's selections are blind beyond the union of its members' coupling closures and separate exactly what the members do not all couple alike. An act differing only beyond that union, the pool's own included, is selected alike within it; a formation whose admission the act changes separates it.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A group's closure under a relation, the least region closed under it that holds every member, is the union of the members' closures, and one formation's closure where the group holds only it. A pool's coupling closure is this closure under being affected through what is coupled into; nothing beyond it exchanges with a condition coupled into a formation within it. (`Becoming.WithinClosureOf`, `Becoming.WithinClosureOf.of_member`, `Becoming.closedUnder_withinClosureOf`, `Becoming.withinClosureOf_iff`, `Becoming.withinClosureOf_single`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinPoolCoupling`, `Becoming.Flow.beyond_pool_coupling`)
2. With the rest of the exchange fixed and balance on what the closure couples into, where every member of a part lies beyond a pool's coupling closure, each formation within it couples the levels with and without the part alike at every step, and every selection through the pooled coupling of any group within it selects them alike; Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_all, the law of one formation's closure, is proved as the case of the pool of that formation. (`Becoming.Flow.uncoupled_beyond_pool`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_pool`, `Becoming.Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_all`)
3. Some selection through a pool's pooled coupling holds at one history and fails at another exactly when the members do not all couple them alike; where a member couples them apart, its class is such a selection; where a list holds exactly the members and each member's coupling of the two is decided, a pool separates exactly what some member separates. (`Becoming.Web.pooledClass_selects`, `Becoming.Web.separates_all_iff`, `Becoming.Web.member_separates_all`, `Becoming.Web.separates_all_iff_member`)
4. A formation whose admission at a step differs between two histories separates them through every pool holding it, from that step on. (`Becoming.Web.admission_separates_all`)
5. The selections through a pool's pooled coupling are a member's exactly when whatever that member couples alike every member couples alike; where a member couples two histories alike and the members do not all, some pooled selection goes through no coupling of that member's. (`Becoming.Web.pooled_iff_member`, `Becoming.Web.pool_adds`)
6. The gap for a pool's act: where the rest follows one law of exchange reading through coupling, in two balanced flows with the same formations present and a common start, and the part acts alike within each member's coupling closure drawn through both flows, each formation within the pool's closure couples the flows alike at every step, and every pooled selection of a group within the closure selects them alike. (`Becoming.Flow.ActsAlikeOnPoolCoupled`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsAlikeOnPoolCoupled.within`, `Becoming.Flow.act_alike_pool`, `Becoming.Flow.act_unselected_pool`)
7. Under the same conditions a consequence of the act is, at no step, a selection through the pooled coupling of a group within the closure; with both acts laws of what has stood, the two generated courses are selected alike. The part may be the pool itself, acting jointly. (`Becoming.Flow.consequence_unselected_pool`, `Becoming.act_courses_unselected_pool`)
8. Under the same conditions, a formation that couples the two flows apart up to a step lies beyond the pool's coupling closure. A formation whose admission the act changes at a step is one: its admission there is a selection through the pooled coupling of every group holding it, from that step on, and of no group within the closure at any step. (`Becoming.Flow.apart_beyond_pool`, `Becoming.Flow.act_selected_by_pool`)
9. With a list holding exactly a pool's members and each member's coupling of the two flows decided, a pool separating them has a member that couples them apart, lying beyond the acting pool's coupling closure. (`Becoming.Flow.separating_member_beyond`)
10. In Clearing the source and the dweller follow one law reading no level in both worlds, and the clearer's act differs only beyond its coupling closure. So the pool of the clearer and its source selects the two worlds alike at every step, the dweller lies beyond the clearer's closure, and every pool holding the dweller separates them by its admission at the third step, as no pool within it does. (`Becoming.Clearing.restLaw`, `Becoming.Clearing.restLaw_through`, `Becoming.Clearing.rest_follows`, `Becoming.Clearing.rest_follows_spared`, `Becoming.Clearing.start_alike`, `Becoming.Clearing.clearerSide_closed_either`, `Becoming.Clearing.acts_alike`, `Becoming.Clearing.source_within`, `Becoming.Clearing.pool_closes_gap`)
11. The clearer's own part lies within its coupling closure, and the clearer couples the levels with and without it alike at every step, while every pool holding the dweller couples them apart through the dweller's admission at the third step: lying within a pool's closure does not make a difference separated. (`Becoming.Clearing.withheld_alike_for_clearer`, `Becoming.Clearing.within_closure_unseparated`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. For the act: that the rest follows a law of exchange reading through coupling (ExchangeLaw.Through), balance, the same formations present and a common start, written into each theorem, as in the-gap-for-ones-own-act; for a part beyond the closure: the rest fixed (Flow.WithheldLevels) and balance on what the closure couples into.
- That a selection goes through a pool's pooled coupling (Web.SelectsThroughAll) is a condition, as in selection-through-registration. The member-level converse takes a list holding exactly the members and each member's coupling of the two histories decided (Decided), named where they enter.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which formations pool, or how a pool forms, lasts or resists capture; that a pool's selection responds to what it separates or closes any difference; which acts are taken, or that any is wrong.
- Claims about every later step, such as a formation's ending: the selections are of level histories up to a step.
- The member-level converse without a list or decided coupling: constructively, a pool's separation then gives only that not every member couples the two alike.
- **Counterexample:** Clearing.within_closure_unseparated: blindness beyond a pool's closure is sufficient, not necessary, for a difference to go unseparated by a member: the clearer's part lies within the clearer's closure, the clearer couples the levels with and without it alike, and the dweller couples them apart. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SelectionPool.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The chapter's section 7.4, restated by M1 on 18 October 2026, read "alignment for all is pooled coupling across intelligences" as an open AI reading, adopted on 19 October 2026 by its place in one account (DELEGATED-CHOICES D45), and section 7.3 bounded pooled coupling only for a pool within one formation's coupling closure (Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_all). Ren, 18 October 2026: "what is the light, how can we hold the light to enlight others, and use it as an alignment for all, and what is still missing from it?" and "please make your own pareto frontier decisions, and push the frontier" (provenance, not warrant); the AI chose the item. Reading (the AI's, adopted in one account with the scope of chapter section 7, DELEGATED-CHOICES D45): no pool, however wide, selects what its own joint act does beyond its joint coupling closure; that is selected only through formations beyond it that couple the difference apart, such as those whose support the act changes.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [selection-through-registration](selection-through-registration.md). Reuses Web.SelectsThroughAll, Web.SelectsThrough.all, Web.separates_all, Web.class_selects and Web.admits_through; the delta is a pool's own coupling closure, blindness beyond it, the exactness of what a pool separates, and Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_all re-derived as the case of one formation.
  - Output: Pooled coupling, and a pool within one formation's closure blind beyond it.
  - Input: The same blindness, and exact separation, for any pool, through the member whose closure holds each formation.
  - Preserved conditions: The rest fixed; balance on the conditions coupled in. [Selection.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [the-gap-for-ones-own-act](the-gap-for-ones-own-act.md). Reuses Flow.act_unselected, act_courses_unselected, Flow.ActsAlikeWithin and Flow.ActsAlikeOnCoupled; the delta lifts the gap to a pool's coupling closure, the pool's joint act included, and states what separates the act.
  - Output: The gap for one's own act through any member of the actor's coupling closure.
  - Input: The same gap at a pool's coupling closure, through the member whose closure holds each formation.
  - Preserved conditions: The rest follows a law of exchange reading through coupling; balance; the same formations present; a common start. [SelectionGap.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SelectionGap.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [testing-within-registration](testing-within-registration.md). There one formation's coupling closure, and the clearer's side closed under being affected through what it couples into (Clearing.clearerSide_closed); here a pool's closure is the union of its members', and the clearer's alikeness is derived from a law of exchange.
- related, not a proved adapter: [raising-what-couples-in-draws-from-beyond](raising-what-couples-in-draws-from-beyond.md). There a selection rewarding a rise of what a group couples into rewards drawing from beyond the group's coupling; here what a pool can separate is bounded by its members' coupling closures.
- related, not a proved adapter: [tests-fix-likeness-where-determined](tests-fix-likeness-where-determined.md). Its list searches over decided properties (Becoming.Likeness) give the member-level converse: from not every member coupling alike, a member that couples apart.
- related, not a proved adapter: [what-a-pools-acts-respond-to](what-a-pools-acts-respond-to.md). Derives this record's premise that a selection goes through the pooled coupling for what a pool decides by its acts, where each member's law reads through its coupling, and turns the gap for a pool's act into the gap for its response.
